label: CIG XG-99C XGS-PON ONT
description: XGS-PON ONT (on-board XGS-PON optics) with 1× 10G LAN and no Wi-Fi; XGS-PON line rate 9.953 Gbit/s symmetric on sc-apc, managed over no published management.
notes: The datasheet's model table lists two SKUs: 'XG-99C1 - XGS-PON SFU ONT, 10 Gbps symmetric, 1x 10GBase-T LAN, SC/APC optical, OMCI, AES-128' and 'XG-99C2 - ... 1x 10GBase-T LAN, 10GE + 1GE, SC/APC optical, OMCI, AES-128'. This entry is the 10GBase-T-only configuration; the second Ethernet port makes the other a different device, because the interface list cannot tell them apart. Optical: ITU-T G.9807.1 Class N1, up to 20 km, +4 to +9 dBm TX, -28 dBm RX. The 10GE port is 10GBase-T RJ-45, compatible with 5G/2.5G/1GBase-T by auto-negotiation. Power: 12 V DC external adapter, under 10 W. No Wi-Fi.
